body_html:
Give four people a workspace that feels considered, not crammed. This Offices To Go Ionic four-person benching workstation pairs four laminate worksurfaces on a single shared frame with PET felt divider panels, so an open floor plate gains structure, acoustic privacy, and a clean institutional look in one footprint. The configuration shown arrives in an Asian Night top with crisp Designer White H-legs.

Features

  • Seats four in a combined 96"W x 50"D x 29"H benching footprint
  • PET felt divider panels soften sound and define each station
  • 1" thermally fused laminate tops with a hard-wearing matching 2mm edge
  • Double-wide H-legs built from 2" steel tube with a 1" x 2" cross bar and levelling glides
  • Choose from nine standard Ionic finishes plus premium options, with Tungsten, Black, or Designer White legs
  • Tested to ANSI/BIFMA standards and GREENGUARD certified for low-emission indoor air quality

Specifications

Made in Canada by Global Furniture Group. Ships as a combined workstation with PET felt divider panels; assembly and electrical are not included. Parts: ML50HE, ML50H, two MVLPET42-1 felt panels, and four INV2448TOP worksurfaces. Also available in other top and leg colours.

Family-owned since 1964, Brant Business Interiors supplies Canadian-made institutional furniture from 296 George St N, Peterborough ON, and is an OECM-eligible supplier — Ontario public-sector buyers can purchase without an open tender.
